description: Author, validate, and export svgif projects. Studio is the human surface. This plugin is the optional agent surface.

skills.name: svgif-author
skills.description: Create or edit a svgif project JSON file with the svgif CLI. Use when the user wants a new animation, a scaffold, or a change to a project document.

skills.name: svgif-validate
skills.description: Validate or migrate a svgif project and explain schema errors. Use when the user asks whether a project file is valid or how to update it to the current schema.

skills.name: svgif-export
skills.description: Export a svgif project to SVG or HTML, or name the browser-only formats. Use when the user wants a file they can open, embed, or hand to Studio.
